title: Austin: Paving Projects, Fines Remitted
summary:
*   **Major Paving Project for West 5th Street:** Approved a $4,200+ paving initiative for West 5th Street, with property owners contributing a significant portion (over $6 per front foot). A public hearing was set for November 15 for affected owners to discuss their assessments.
*   **East Nellie Street Infrastructure:** Established detailed elevation grades and a 38-foot roadway width for East Nellie Street, mapping out future development or improvements for the area.
*   **Fines and Judgments Adjusted:** Remitted an automobile speeding fine for Helen White and corrected a sewer service judgment against Claud D. Trawick, with the City agreeing to pay associated costs after an administrative error was found.

Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas. November 01, 1917: The Council was
called to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none: The minutes of the last regular and subsequent

the improvement of a certain part of 5th street,in the City of Austin, and approving
specification proposal ,contract and bond therefor, which had been read the first time on

.Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Resolution approving City Engineer's
report concerning improvements upon west 5th street , in this City, from the west property
line of Colorado street to the east curb line of Lavoaca street,and directing a hearing to
property owners concerning the assessment for part of the cost of such improvements
against them and their property,fixing a time for sais hearing and dire oting that a
notice be given to said property owners concerning the said hearing.
Whereas, the City Council of the City of Austin,Texas, has heretofore determine to improve
west 5th street ,from the west property line of Colorado street to the east curb line of
Lavacca street ,in the City of Austin, Texas, by paving the same with standard Bitulithic
pavement upon gravel concrete foundation with concrete gutters along curb lines and
necessary excavation ,and has adopted specifications for said work and has entered into a
contract for the same with the Texas Bitulithic Company a Corporation ; and Whereas, the
City Engineer of the City of Austin,Texas, has this day filed his report in writingwith
the City Council,showing the total cost of the said improvements upon the said street ,the
amount per front foot of abutting property to be paid by the owners thereof and also the
names of persons,estates or corporations owning property abutting on said improvements
,with a description of their property and a statement of the total amount payable byeach
of said owners for said improvements ; and Whereas, the necessityexists that a portion of
the cost of said improvements should be assessed against said property owners and their
property,subject to the terms of the

Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas : 1. That the said report
of the City Engineer,be and the same is hereby approved and adopted.
2. That a portion of the cost of making the said improvements shll be assessed against
said owners of property abutting on west 5th street,in this City, from the west property
line of Colorado street to the east curb line of Lavacca street,in the City of Austin,
Texas, and against said property, that the said assessment shall be made at the rate of $
6.8933(not including curbing ) per front foot of such property in accordance with the
front foot rule or plan,in proportion as the frontage of each owner in each block of said
street, is to the whole frontage in that block to be improved, provided that if said rule
of apportionment shaal appear to the City Council to be unjust or unequal in any
particular case ,or to result in an assessment in excess of the benefits received through
said improvement by any owner or his property ,the City Council shall adopt such rule of
apportionment as shall effect substantial equality and justice between said property
owners,consid-ering benefits received by and burdens imposed upon said owners, and that in
no case shall any assessment be made in excess of the actual benefits received by the
owner of said property throgh the enhanced value thereof by means of said improvements.
3.That a hearing shall be given before the Council to said property owners on the 15th day
of November,A D 1917, at ten O'clock A M,in the City of Austin, Texas, at which hearing
said property owners ,their agents or attornys shall be fully and fairly heard as to all
matters concerning the said improvements or any irregularity or invalidity in the
proceedings with refer-ence thereto,or as to the benefits thereof, if any, to their
property,and as to the assessment proposed to be made against them and their property,and
as to any other matter or thing connected therewith.At which hearing the said owners shall
have the rightto produce witnesses and testimony,and which hearing shall be adjourned from
time to time and from day to day until all as are fully heard and all matters in
connection with the said improvements and assessment fully ascertained; that after the
said hearing shall be closed, said City Council will proceed to assess against owners of
property upon said street and their property,who shall agree with the said Council upon
the said assessments .such sums as may be so agreed upon. and determined as provided by
the Charter of the City and the said ordinance;and that as to any such property owners who
may not so agree,the City Council will, after said hearig appoint a commission to
determine said assessment,and will take such further steps in ascertainment thereof as are
provided by the Charter and ordinance.
4. That the Supt of streets and public improvements of the said City of Austin,is hereby
directed to givw notice hereof to the said property owners, their agents and attorneys by

Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Whereas, it appears that there is a
judgement in Justice M M Johnson's Court of this City against Claud D Trawick in the sum
of $ 11.25,and costs amounting to $ 3.35 for sewer service appariently owing by the said
Claud D Trawickon his premises at 3904 Avenue "C",Dyde Park, City of Austin, Texas, and
Whereas, it appears that the said Claud D Trawick had sold said premises to one Hudson
Maud on May 15th 1916, and was not liable for sewer service thereafter; and Whereas, it
further appears from the statement of H B Barnhart ,Special Attorney,that the said Claud
Trawick was not to be sued for sewer rentals in arrears until an apportionment of the
amount owing should be made between the said Claud D Trawick and the said Hudson Maud ;
and Whereas, it appears from the same statement of the said H B Barnhart, special Attorney
in charge of sewer connections ,that said suit was brought in error; and Whereas, it
appears that $ 5.62 is the full amount of the sewer rentals in arrears on said premises at
No 3904. venue "C",Hyde Park, owning by the said Claud D Trawick,
Now therefore,
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas: That upon payment of $
5.62 ,by the said Claud D Trawick,to the Cashier of the sewer department ,the judgement
